_comment: 英文短语库。译名一经确定即全库复用——天阙永远是 the Celestial Gate,译名漂移会让英文模型上的成套感断裂。LIGHT/FOREGROUND/FARFADE 按光时/经卦取中英短语;EN 按卦序(字符串键)取该卦远景人物/天候/水势的英文。组件一律存裸短语,框架词只由模板添加一次。

拂晓.zh: 拂晓逆光，日尚在山脊之下，天光自主体背后透出
拂晓.en: first light before sunrise, the sun still below the ridge, backlighting the scene from behind

正午.en: a high noon sun directly overhead

薄暮.zh: 薄暮低斜光，日将没，自画面左侧掠入
薄暮.en: a low sun minutes from setting, raking in from the left

夜.en: moonlight from high on the left

乾.zh: 被罡风蚀过的白玉栏杆

坎.zh: 湿黑的岩石与一道水帘
坎.en: wet black rock and a hanging water curtain

兌.en: dark lotus stems and spent leaves

離.en: a few last points of lamplight

兌.en: open water stretching past any shore

1.figure: three women climbing the vermilion stair, robes pulled straight by the wind, none looking back
1.terrain: the vapour below lying flat as a mirror

2.figure: three women walking slowly between the terraces, unhurried
2.weather: low mist creeping over the stepped fields
2.terrain: bare earth, no standing water, the dust settled

3.figure: a woman standing motionless on the broken rock, her hem soaked through
3.weather: a downpour just ended, the thunderheads not yet dispersed
3.terrain: muddy water rising over the altar steps

4.figure: a woman taking one testing step forward into the fog
4.terrain: a newborn spring seeping out from under the mountain

5.figure: two women halted at the water, not advancing
5.weather: heavy cloud pressed low, the rain gathered but not yet falling
5.terrain: the water surface frozen still, everything waiting

6.figure: two women facing each other across the water, neither giving way
6.weather: high wind above meeting water vapour below

7.figure: three women standing in silent file, evenly spaced
7.terrain: water held beneath the earth, the surface unbroken

8.figure: three women gathered in a ring, all turned inward
8.weather: the sky opened, thin cloud burnt away
8.terrain: water flat as a mirror, reflecting the whole realm

9.figure: a woman looking up at the cloud, waiting for rain that will not fall
9.weather: dense cloud that refuses to release its rain
9.terrain: the bed dry, the water withdrawn

10.figure: a woman stepping carefully onto the mirrored water
10.terrain: water stilled to the hardness of ice

11.figure: three women passing up and down between the two realms
11.weather: clear sky, vapour threading continuously between above and below

12.figure: a woman held below, looking up at what she cannot reach
12.weather: a dead layer of cloud sealing the middle, above and below cut apart
12.terrain: the water below run dry, nothing descending from above

13.figure: three women converging on one point from different directions
13.weather: clear sky, fire and heaven mirroring each other
13.terrain: still water reflecting one shared sky

14.figure: three women below the golden roof, their robes the brightest thing in the picture
14.terrain: still water throwing back the gold of the roof

15.figure: a woman bending to the water, never straightening
15.weather: thin mist rising from below the mountain
15.terrain: low water, level, contending with nothing

16.figure: three women with heads raised, as if waiting for thunder that has not yet broken
16.weather: thunderheads breaking, light pouring through the gap

17.figure: three women following the current in single file
17.weather: thin mist drifting sideways with the wind
17.terrain: water running with the slope, nothing held back

18.figure: a woman standing alone among the ruined lotus
18.weather: stagnant fog that will not lift
18.terrain: water rotted down to the bed, lotus collapsed into mud

19.figure: two women looking down at the water, their reflections beneath

19.terrain: water risen several steps, about to reach the courtyard

20.figure: a woman standing high on the gallery, gazing far out
20.weather: mist below, the height alone clear
20.terrain: the water a mirror, held for the high vantage

21.figure: a woman standing with something held tight, her back rigid
21.weather: lightning through cloud, the storm about to break
21.terrain: water striking the rocks, sharp and forceful

22.figure: two women facing their own reflections in the water
22.weather: thin mist carrying the afterglow, colouring everything

23.figure: a woman on steps that are beginning to give way
23.weather: fine snow falling, not yet settling

24.figure: a woman climbing up from below, the only thing moving
24.weather: snow just cleared, one seam opening in the cloud
24.terrain: the first meltwater seeping up from below

25.figure: three women scattered by the sudden rain, each going a different way
25.weather: thunder and rain arriving abruptly, cloud like a lid
25.terrain: water surging up brown from nowhere

26.figure: three women seated along the steps, none of them rising
26.weather: clear and bright, the wind stopped, the cloud anchored
26.terrain: water held in the pool, not flowing

27.figure: two women bending to the water, their movements identical
27.weather: mist clean and moist enough to drink
27.terrain: still water clear enough to look into

28.figure: a woman standing on a beam about to go under

28.terrain: water over the beams, close to the roof

29.figure: a woman standing against the current, water past her shins

29.terrain: torrents falling tier after tier, ceaseless

30.figure: two women walking slowly around the flame
30.weather: white-hot clear sky, not one cloud
30.terrain: the water burnt off, the stone bleached

31.figure: two women standing shoulder to shoulder, their sleeves touching
31.weather: mist rising off the marsh and turning back at the mountain
31.terrain: marsh water reaching the foot of the mountain

32.figure: two women standing so long they might be stone

32.terrain: the water level unchanged for years

33.figure: a woman withdrawing into the mountain shadow, half of her already gone

33.terrain: water gone into the rock, only damp remaining

34.figure: three women standing into the wind, every robe streaming back
34.weather: high wind tearing the cloud, thunder overhead
34.terrain: water striking the cliff and thrown back

36.figure: a woman hidden in the dark, only a line of pale robe showing

37.figure: three women gathered under one eave, older and younger together

37.terrain: the courtyard pool still, holding the lit windows

38.figure: two women back to back, each facing away

38.terrain: two pools drying separately, never meeting

39.figure: a woman caught to the waist in the frozen water, unable to move
39.weather: packed snow closing the road, wind carrying grains of ice

40.figure: three women with sleeves loosened, walking out of the gorge
40.weather: the storm just ended, the cloud splitting open

41.figure: a woman standing on the mark the water left
41.weather: mist thinning, the air giving something up
41.terrain: water withdrawn, leaving band after band of old tideline

42.figure: three women opening their sleeves slightly in the fine rain
42.terrain: water rising slowly, reaching the roots

43.figure: three women hurrying clear of the water, every hem thrown up
43.weather: high wind ripping the cloud, light straight down
43.terrain: a breached bank, water pouring across

44.figure: a woman passing an unexpected figure at the foot of the gallery

44.terrain: one fine line opening across the still water

45.figure: three women massed so close they almost merge

46.figure: a woman spiralling up the stair, higher with each turn

46.terrain: water climbing the steps one level at a time

47.figure: a woman stranded at the centre of the dry marsh, her sleeves hanging

47.terrain: the marsh bed cracked, not a drop left

48.figure: a woman bending over the well
48.weather: mist over the wellmouth, air rising out of the shaft
48.terrain: well water deep and unmoving, clear enough to mirror a face

49.figure: three women in changed robes, the old ones lying on the water

49.terrain: water and fire cancelling, the level dropping fast

50.figure: two women stationed either side of the steps like guards

50.terrain: still water, the vessel reflected without a tremor

51.figure: three women turning to look back at the same instant

51.terrain: the water shattering inch by inch

52.figure: a woman standing still so long she seems rooted

52.terrain: the water absolutely unrippled, as if set

53.figure: three women climbing the stair in order, pausing at each level

54.figure: two women one ahead and one behind, never abreast

55.figure: three women filling the terrace, their robes at their brightest

55.terrain: the water full and level, at its height

56.terrain: water too shallow to stay in

57.figure: three women standing downwind, every robe laid flat

58.figure: three women playing at the water, spray thrown up

59.figure: three women scattering, no two on the same heading

60.figure: two women stationed either side of the divide

61.figure: three women calling to each other through the mist, one older and two young

62.figure: a woman moving low across the ridge, never rising to full height

63.figure: three women each in her own place, evenly spaced
